# Vendored libraries

Kept in the repo so the app works offline with no CDN. Used for Anki import/export and loaded only when needed.

| File | Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| sql-wasm.js, sql-wasm.wasm | [sql.js](https://github.com/sql-js/sql.js) | 1.10.3 | MIT |
| jszip.min.js | [JSZip](https://github.com/Stuk/jszip) | 3.10.1 | MIT (dual MIT/GPLv3) |
| fzstd.mjs | [fzstd](https://github.com/101arrowz/fzstd) | 0.1.1 | MIT |
